entries.text: 恭喜喔，死黨！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_01

entries.text: 從現在開始，[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳\n就是藍莓聯盟的新冠軍！[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_02

entries.text: 成為冠軍的傢伙，\n可以獲得學園準備的獎品。\r\n獎品在我這裡，就交給[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳了～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_03

entries.text: 雖然我這個輸給你的人\n沒什麼資格說這話……[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_05

entries.text: 但是讓我們像以前那樣\n開開心心對戰吧。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_06

entries.text: 能有一分執著去追求勝利，\n是很棒的事，\r\n不論是誰，都是想贏的嘛。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_07

entries.text: 但是啊……太鑽牛角尖，\n把自己逼到喘不過氣，那就不對了。\r\n……我光是看著都覺得難受。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_08

entries.text: 所以啊，\n就再和大家一起……[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_09

entries.text: 我不會輸……下……\n下次我絕對……會贏……\r\n下次……絕對……[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_brother_02

entries.text: 搭話
entries.label: sdc02_0220_select_01

entries.text: 不搭話
entries.label: sdc02_0220_select_02

entries.text: 呃～……請問～\n我可以打擾一下嗎～？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_fairybb_01

entries.text: 剛才真的好厲害！\n平常的話，我會想幫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳好好慶祝……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_fairybb_03

entries.text: 但是現在……\n這個狀況對我們來說有些複雜，\r\n需要整理一下才行……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_fairybb_04

entries.text: 要不，你想想看！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_fairybb_05

entries.text:
[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她成為冠軍之後，
也就是聯盟社的社長了。
[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她是留學生，所以這根本是史無前例，
但往後的方針要怎麼辦！？
這個那個、那個這個，有一堆問題呢！！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_fairybb_06

entries.text: 而且烏栗從冠軍\n降為四天王的話，\r\n以排名來說是赤松會被擠出去。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_fairybb_07

entries.text: 欸，我要被炒了嗎！？\n那可不妙啊！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_firebb_01

entries.text: 我們得好好聽聽看\n烏栗他想怎麼辦才行……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_fairybb_08

entries.text: 鈴　啷　噹　啷～♪
entries.label: sdc02_0220_system_01

entries.text: 這裡是廣播室。\n以下同學請注意。
entries.label: sdc02_0220_announcement_01

entries.text: 聯盟社冠軍烏栗同學，\n四天王首席杜若同學。
entries.label: sdc02_0220_announcement_02

entries.text: ３年２班丹瑜同學，\n交換留學生[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同學。
entries.label: sdc02_0220_announcement_03

entries.text: 白蕾雅老師與客人\n有事找你們。
entries.label: sdc02_0220_announcement_04

entries.text: 請盡快到１－４教室報到。
entries.label: sdc02_0220_announcement_05

entries.text: 啷　鈴　啷　噹～♪
entries.label: sdc02_0220_system_02

entries.text: 真是的，\n怎麼偏偏在這種時候……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_fairybb_09

entries.text: 烏栗明明已經不是冠軍了啊～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_14

entries.text: 杜若！\n我、覺、得！\r\n那是不好的！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_fairybb_10

entries.text: 白蕾雅老師的事要是放著不管，\n之後可麻煩了。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_15

entries.text: 烏栗那傢伙，我就算是用背的，\n也會把他背過去的。[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_18

entries.text: 恭喜[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在冠軍戰獲勝！\c\n……沒辦法盡情地幫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳慶祝，\n真是抱歉。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_fairybb_11

entries.text: 廣播是要我們去１－４教室對吧？\n死黨，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳先去吧～[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_dragonbb_17

entries.text: 如果我不再是四天王的話，\n就不能使用草原廣場的四天王區域，\r\n那可頭痛了～！[VAR 0x0114(0047)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_firebb_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，謝謝……\n別擔心阿栗的事，\r\n我們得去白蕾雅老師那裡了。[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
entries.label: sdc02_0220_sister_01
